description: Land Acquisition- Menikhinna, Kundasale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for a public purpose, including lot numbers, names, descriptions, extents, and claimant information. The content focuses solely on land matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
